Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 dummy VARCHAR2(1);
begin
 :global.dup_contract := '';
 :global.no_contract := '';
 select substr(company,1,38),center_id
 into :control_block.company,
 :control_block.center_id
 from contracts
 where contract_id = :control_block.contract_id
 --and chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id
 and LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y' --MLT 244 Code changes - As user able to select contract id linked with chapter id
 and contract_type = 'RG'
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365)
 and exists (select 'x' from rgt_batch bat
 where bat.chapter_id = contracts.chapter_id and
 bat.contract_id = contracts.contract_id
 and rownum = 1)
 and rownum = 1;
 exception
 when too_many_rows then
 :global.dup_contract := 'Y';
 show_error('1060');
 check_package_failure;
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 select 'x' into dummy
 from contracts
 where --chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id
 LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y' --MLT 244 Code changes - As user able to select contract id linked with chapter id
 and upper(company) like '%'||upper(:contract_id)||'%'
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365)
 and exists (select 'x' from rgt_batch bat
 where bat.chapter_id = contracts.chapter_id and
 bat.contract_id = contracts.contract_id and
 rownum = 1)
 and rownum=1;
 :global.no_contract := 'N';
 list_values;
 GO_ITEM('control_block.contract_id');
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then bell;
 :global.no_contract := 'Y';
 show_error('1147');
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 when others
 then handle_error;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 dummy VARCHAR2(1);
 units_found VARCHAR2(1);
begin
 units_found := 'Y';
 nullchk;
 if :control_block.upload_date is null then
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 if (nvl(:global.date_found,'Y') = 'N') then
 show_error('1071');
 check_package_failure;
 GO_ITEM('control_block.upload_date');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 erase('global.date_found');
 begin
 select 'x' into dummy from rgt_units ru
 where
 ru.chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id
 and ru.contract_id = :control_block.contract_id
 and ru.batch_id in (
 select distinct rgt.batch_id
 from rgt_batch rgt
 where rgt.chapter_id =
 ru.chapter_id
 and rgt.contract_id =
 ru.contract_id
 and trunc(rgt.upload_date) =
 :control_block.upload_date)
 and rownum = 1;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 units_found := 'N';
 show_error('1071');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 if units_found = 'Y' then
 NEXT_ITEM;
 else
 GO_ITEM('control_block.upload_date');
 show_error('1071');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
exception
 when others then
 check_package_failure;
 handle_error;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare dummy VARCHAR2(1);
 v_units_time date;
 v_local_time date;
begin
 :global.done := '0';
 begin
 -- Added by HCL-C to calculate check digit
 :units.os_chk_digit:=chk_digit_query(:units.unit_id, null, null);

 select distinct 'x' into dummy from rgt_tests where
 chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id and
 contract_id = :control_block.contract_id and
 batch_id = :units.batch_id and
 unit_id = :units.unit_id;
 :units.additional_tests := 'Y';
-- if SQL%FOUND = TRUE then
-- :units.additional_tests := 'Y';
-- else
-- :units.additional_tests := 'N';
-- end if;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :units.additional_tests := 'N';
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 begin 
 
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 select upload_date into v_units_time
 from rgt_batch
 where contract_id = :control_block.contract_id
 and chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id
 and batch_id = :units.batch_id
 and trunc(upload_date) = :control_block.upload_date;
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,v_units_time,v_local_time);
 :units.time := to_char(v_local_time,'HH24:MI');
 
 else
 select to_char(upload_date,'HH24:MI') into :units.time
 from rgt_batch
 where contract_id = :control_block.contract_id
 and chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id
 and batch_id = :units.batch_id
 and trunc(upload_date) = :control_block.upload_date;
 end if; 
 -- 
 
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;

 begin
 
 v_local_time := null;
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 select red1_flag, purple1_flag, purple2_flag,
 tube_check_in_date
 into :units.red1, :units.purple1,
 :units.purple2,:units.tc_date
 from rgt_tubes
 where cbc_unit_id = :units.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id
 and contract_id = :control_block.contract_id;
 if :units.tc_date is not null then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:units.tc_date,v_local_time);
 --message('Gmt date time .:units.tc_date .: '||to_char(:units.tc_date,'mm/dd/yyyy hh24:mi')); pause; ---tmppp
 :units.tc_date := v_local_time;
 
 -- message('Gmt to local dt time..truncdt: : '||to_char(v_local_time,'mm/dd/yyyy hh24:mi')||' truncdt: '||to_Char(:units.tc_date,'mm/dd/yyyy hh24:mi')); pause; ---tmppp
 end if; -- not null
 else -- timezone
 select red1_flag, purple1_flag, purple2_flag,
 tube_check_in_date
 into :units.red1, :units.purple1,
 :units.purple2,:units.tc_date
 from rgt_tubes
 where cbc_unit_id = :units.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id
 and contract_id = :control_block.contract_id;
 end if; --timezone 
 -- 
 
 
 
 /* select red1_flag, purple1_flag, purple2_flag,
 tube_check_in_date
 into :units.red1, :units.purple1,
 :units.purple2,:units.tc_date
 from rgt_tubes
 where cbc_unit_id = :units.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id
 and contract_id = :control_block.contract_id;*/
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 begin
 select unit_id into :internal_unit_id
 from units
 where chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id
 and contract_id = :control_block.contract_id
 and os_unit_id = :units.unit_id;

 -- Added by HCL-C to calculate os check digit
 :units.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(:units.internal_unit_id, null, null);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null; /* It could be blank if no tubes checked in */
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADD_TEST_RESULTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Add_test_results IS
BEGIN
 go_block('add');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 GO_ITEM('units.s_arrow');
 go_block('tests');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_item('units.s_arrow');

 if :units.profile_tests = 'Y' then
 go_block('tests');
 execute_query;
 go_item('units.s_arrow');
 end if;
 if :units.additional_tests = 'Y' then
 go_block('add');
 execute_query;
 GO_ITEM('units.s_arrow');
 end if;
END;

RecordGroup.Name: UNITS_BATCH_ID_LOV3
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select bu.batch_id,bu.received_date,bu.qc_date,bu.number_of_units from batch_inputs bu where bu.contract_id = :control_block.contract_id and bu.chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id and not exists (select 'x' from rgt_results_batch ru where ru.result_batch_id = bu.batch_id and ru.chapter_id = bu.chapter_id) and bu.qc_date is not null order by bu.received_date desc, bu.batch_id

RecordGroup.Name: CONTROL_BLO_BATCH_ID_LOV2
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select distinct batch_id, substr(to_char(upload_date,'MM-DD-YY'),1,8), units_count cnt from rgt_batch bat where chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id and contract_id = :control_block.contract_id and trunc(upload_date) = :control_block.upload_date order by 1, 2 desc

RecordGroup.Name: CONTROL_BLO_UPLOAD_DATE_LOV1
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select to_char(upload_date,'mm-dd-yy'), trunc(upload_date) , substr (batch_id,1,14), units_count cnt from rgt_batch bat where bat.chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id and bat.contract_id = :control_block.contract_id and exists (select 'x' from rgt_units rgt where rgt.chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id and rgt.contract_id = :control_block.contract_id and rgt.batch_id = bat.batch_id ) order by bat.batch_id, bat.upload_date desc /* selecting upload_date twice - one for displaying in mmddyy format and the other for selecting it in actual format. */

RecordGroup.Name: CONTROL_BLO_CONTRACT_ID_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select contract_id,substr(company,1,38),center_id from contracts where LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y' and (upper(company) like upper('%'||:contract_id||'%') or (contract_id like '%'||:contract_id||'%')) and contract_type = 'RG' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) and exists (select 'x' from rgt_batch bat where bat.chapter_id = contracts.chapter_id and bat.contract_id = contracts.contract_id) order by company
